title: One rack, one frontier model
author: timfurlong
prompt: Build a visual representation of the data center server setup that would be used for running a frontier model like Opus 5.5. Many details are not public, so estimate as necessary. Show the setup necessary for running a single instance of the model for inference only (not training), to understand how cutting-edge AI data centers are put together, including SXM or OAM mezzanine forms, tensor parallelism, NVSwitch trays, shared memory pools, scale-out fabric, RoCE and InfiniBand, and liquid cooling. Build the figures with education in mind.
